name: Scream Tail
description: Scream Tail, the Paradox Pokémon. A Fairy and Psychic type.
pokedex_entries: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.
It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.
